lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I wanna talk to you about something.
Hmm? What's up?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You know how Absolute

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: has gotten closer lately, right?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Eunhwa and Vesti

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: have been getting along really well these days! ^__^

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: It's really great to see,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: but I think they're pushing themselves a little too hard.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: So I'm not sure what I should do about it. T.T
Pushing themselves?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I used to be the one in charge of cooking,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: and the other two handled stuff

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: like cleaning and tidying up.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: But lately,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: they've been saying they want to take turns cooking.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: They said they feel bad for making me do it all the time.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: It's really sweet of them,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: but now that they've actually started helping out,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: they both seem really exhausted. >.<

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: As you know, Commander,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I love cooking!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: It's fine for me to do it every day,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: but it's a different story for Eunhwa and Vesti.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: They're always stressing over

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: what to make and how to make it.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I tried saying I'd take over the cooking duty,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: but they're completely against it! >.<

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: It's so hard watching them struggle like that... What do you think I should do?
How about helping them secretly?
How about helping out with the cleanup or something?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh my,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I was thinking the same thing too, hehe!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Great minds really do think alike.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I've already been helping out with the cleanup,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: but I think the problem lies with the cooking. T_T

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: What if I help them secretly?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Then I'd feel at ease, and it'd help the both of them too.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Two birds, one stone, right? ^__^
... It looks like Emma's asking a question she already knows the answer to.
Yeah, I think it's fine to do whatever you want.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You really think so?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I feel so much better knowing that you agree, hehe!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I'll give it a try starting today.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Thanks for hearing me out, Commander!
... I think it'd be best to contact Eunhwa and Vesti separately about this.
